simple.meaning: רָצַד (râtsad) is a Hebrew action word meaning “probably to look askant , i.e. (figuratively) be jealous.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 68:17. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָצַד (H7520) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
